newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Q2 c/a deficit 718 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Q2 c/a deficit 718 mln kroons.

text.p: Estonia's current account deficit dipped to 718.7 million kroons in the second quarter of the year, compared with a revised 1.11 billion kroons deficit in the first three months, the central bank said on Thursday.
But it showed a rise compared with the current account deficit of 695.5 million kroons in the second quarter of last year, the bank said in a statement.
The overall Q2 balance of payments was 547.2 million kroons, compared with 123.3 million kroons in the first quarter.
The bank said Estonia's trade deficit in the second quarter was 2.69 billion kroons versus a Q1 2.36 billion kroon deficit.
It said the trade deficit grew due to the import of capital goods as the Estonian economy continues to restructure.
The capital and financial account came to 795.9 million kroons, versus 1.2 billion kroons in the first quarter.
The balance of payments data showed a negative figure for direct investment the first time at minus 200 million kroons.

The bank said this was explained by the previously high level of foreign investment and some big Estonian investments abroad, such as the City of Tallinn bond issue and the expansion of Estonian banks to neighbouring Latvia.
